about.title: About us
about.description: When the Mook Group opened Zenzakan in 2009, it ushered in a completely new era of Asian fine dining. Even in glamorous metropolises like Dubai, Shanghai, or New York, comparably spectacular locations were extremely scarce. It was clear that the Mook Group had once again impressively succeeded in completely redefining the standards in the German hospitality industry. Zenzakan was accordingly showered with praise. But it also immediately convinced culinarily. For example, shortly after the opening, we succeeded in bringing the title for the best foreign restaurant in Germany to Frankfurt. However, it has never been one of the great strengths of the Mook Group to arrogantly rest on its laurels. We have therefore continuously worked to improve Zenzakan both visually and culinarily. Through this tireless commitment, we have managed to define the benchmark for Asian fine dining in Germany even today. But enough of superlatives. You should best make your own picture of Zenzakan now! You will very quickly find that our almost euphoric description is only surpassed by the overwhelming reality.

privateDining.title: Private Dining
privateDining.description: Zenzakan, with its phenomenally fitted and furnished 2,000 square metres, is the ideal haven for any kind of event. Thanks to various rooms that can be interconnected all sorts of modular ways, countless constellations and event sizes are possible. This means we can organise virtually any type and size of event to perfection.

geisha.title: Geisha Room
geisha.description: The Geisha Room is a burlesque chambre séparée that can just about accommodate two people. The intimate space is decorated with sensual photographic art, indirect lighting and an inviting chaise longue. The enchanting oasis is the perfect retreat for a romantic tête-à-tête. Marriage proposals are especially popular in the Geisha Room.

contact.title: Contact & Directions
contact.valet_description: Zenzakan is located in the same building as the Ivory Club. Of course, you can use the valet parking service of the Ivory Club.
